# A GitHub build attestation for a Soroban contract

`reflector-dao-attestation.json` is what GitHub's API answered on
2026-10-15 for
`/repos/reflector-network/reflector-dao-contract/attestations/sha256:f60d33ec57eecee04b52d048c1c079983ff1b3834c8195fea811b025fb889361`,
the SHA-256 of `reflector-dao-contract_v1.1.0.wasm` from that repository's
release `v1.1.0_reflector-dao-contract_cli22.0.1`. Reflector's contracts are
the example SEP-55 itself uses. Public data; the tests use it to check how
an attestation is read.
